title: Article 239AB — Provision in case of failure of constitutional machinery

content.overview: Article 239AB — Provision in case of failure of constitutional machinery. Complete constitutional treatise with procedural anchors, cases, and chamber drafting blueprints.
content.study:
Topic at a Glance
Article 239AB of the Constitution of India is titled “Provision in case of failure of constitutional machinery”. It forms an integral component of The Union Territories (Articles 239–242), located within the “Union Territories” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
If the President, on receipt of a report from the Lieutenant Governor or otherwise, is satisfied—

(a) that a situation has arisen in which the administration of the National Capital Territory cannot be carried on in accordance with the provisions of article 239AA or of any law made in pursuance of that article; or

(b) that for the proper administration of the National Capital Territory it is necessary or expedient so to do, the President may by order suspend the operation of any provision of article 239AA or of all or any of the provisions of any law made in pursuance of that . \
